content.summary: The integrated numerical narrative keeps point counts, member counts, representation sizes, and arithmetic-domain sizes distinct. No inspected sentence implies a measured speedup. Fresh snapshot and manuscript hashes match.

checks.scope: Units and populations across the quantitative narrative
checks.method: Read the entire frozen manuscript, tracking the abstract, support theorems, grid paragraph, finite equivalence, failed-search paragraph, and representation comparison.
checks.observation: The 53 bound counts supported points of a 28-member family; 112 counts incidences. The 1,484 incidence bits equal 28 times 53, whereas 292,825 counts candidate four-subsets for a different representation. The 8,855/6,031 counts concern degree quadruples, not families. The budget-59 diagnostic explicitly constructs no family and establishes no optimality. The 150-second search budget is reported separately from representation counts, with no solver outcome. The text expressly disclaims measured speedups, so these quantities are not combined into an unsupported performance claim.
